question: An ability triggers whenever damage is dealt. If all of that damage is prevented, does the ability trigger?

expected.shortAnswer: No: an ability that triggers on damage being dealt does not trigger if all the damage is prevented.
expected.answer: An ability that triggers on damage being dealt won’t trigger if all the damage is prevented.
